description: Fix a bug described in words: reproduce it with the tests, diagnose the root cause (read-only), patch, verify by the test process, then an independent review of the diff. Чинит баг по описанию: воспроизвести, найти причину, поправить, проверить, показать ревью.

nodes.instruction: Baseline: run the tests before touching anything.
Run the tests again; the exit code decides.

Review the change just made for this bug: {{task}}
Read the diff (read_git_diff). Is it minimal, correct, free of side effects? Answer with the JSON object: review_verdict="ok" or "concerns", review_notes=<one or two sentences>.
